title: 星巴克CEO：未来或走向多品牌组合
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Has there been discussions about the idea that maybe Starbucks could pursue a multi-brand model for Starbucks court?
segments.zh: 是否讨论过星巴克可能采用多品牌模式的想法？

segments.en: Yeah, look, I think it's one of those possibilities.
segments.zh: 是的，我认为这是一种可能性。

segments.en: The good news is Starbucks is such a strong business and our scale presents an opportunity to go beyond just being a one brand company.
segments.zh: 好消息是星巴克业务非常强劲，我们的规模提供了超越单一品牌公司的机会。

segments.en: That's not our focus right now, but is it an opportunity down the road?
segments.zh: 这不是我们现在的重点，但未来是否是个机会？

segments.en: You know, I would never say never, but look, I think when you've got a strong business like Starbucks, I think you put other businesses into a portfolio that could leverage the
segments.zh: 我永远不会说绝不，但我认为当你有星巴克这样强大的业务时，你可以将其他业务纳入组合，利用

segments.en: strength of Starbucks. That could be an interesting proposition down the road.
segments.zh: 星巴克的优势。未来这可能是一个有趣的提议。

segments.en: How far have any talks gone with any other potential parties this year?
segments.zh: 今年与其他潜在方的谈判进展如何？

segments.en: You know, that has not been our focus. Our focus is first getting the turnaround and getting Starbucks into a growth situation.
segments.zh: 这不是我们的重点。我们的重点是首先实现转型，让星巴克进入增长状态。

segments.en: And I think that's what we demonstrated, you know, this quarter, and I think you'll continue to see us demonstrate in this fiscal year.
segments.zh: 我认为这就是我们在本季度所展示的，并且在本财年将继续展示。

segments.en: Would you be open to pursuing M&A as a way to meet some of your growth targets beyond organically?
segments.zh: 你是否愿意通过并购来实现一些增长目标，而不仅仅是有机增长？

segments.en: Now look, the good news is I don't need inorganic to hit our growth targets.
segments.zh: 好消息是，我们不需要靠外部收购来实现增长目标。

segments.en: I am in a position of strength. We're in no rush to do anything outside of our back to Starbucks growth plan.
segments.zh: 我们处于有利地位，不急于在‘回归星巴克’增长计划之外采取任何行动。

segments.en: So now look, I think I wouldn't be doing my job if I wasn't taking a look at what's out there.
segments.zh: 所以，如果我不关注外部机会，那就是失职了。
